messages.text: What are the most important signal generation capabilities for applications in AI?

The passages support prioritizing AI-ready signal generation around automated end-to-end test planning, smart execution of complex test scenarios, lab-management integration, DUT capability management, and log-based result/root-cause analysis, because the RAW AI outlook lists these as the focus areas for agentic AI in CONTEST sequencer operation [37].
For test-and-measurement signal generators themselves, the key capabilities are wide RF frequency coverage, wide RF modulation bandwidth, standards-based signal generation, OFDM/custom digital modulation, arbitrary waveform generation, multicarrier waveforms, MIMO/multichannel expansion, fading/channel emulation, and programmable trigger/marker control [5][6][28].
R&S SMW200A is relevant where AI test workflows need high-end vector signal generation, because the Wiki states it covers RF path A from 100 kHz to 67 GHz and can scale from a single-path vector signal generator to a multichannel MIMO receiver tester [3].
For component-level wireless testing, the supported SMW200A capabilities include frequency up to 67 GHz, overrange to 72 GHz, RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz, up to 4 GHz with R&S SMW-K555, and signal generation software for LTE, Cellular IoT, 5G NR R17/18, OFDM, and custom digital modulation [28].
For interference and multi-signal test cases, multicarrier generation matters, because SMCV100B supports up to 512 carriers and total RF bandwidth up to 240 MHz with K523 [5].
For repeatable automated execution, trigger and marker control matter, because SMCV100B supports internal or external trigger sources, multiple trigger modes, external trigger input, trigger jitter of ±1.67 ns, and LVTTL marker output [5].
【推論】The most AI-relevant signal-generator capability is not only RF performance but controllable scenario automation, because RAW AI evidence emphasizes automated test plan generation and smart execution of complex scenarios, while the signal-generator evidence lists waveform sequencing, modulation, bandwidth, fading, and trigger/marker controls [37][5][6][28][2].

[3] Wiki：R&S SMW200A（來源：`SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600.md`、`SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100.md`）
[5] Wiki：R&S SMCV100B（來源：`SMCV100B_specs_en_3608-0627-22_v1700.md`）
[6] Wiki：R&S SMW200A（來源：`SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600.md`、`SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100.md`）

passages.text:
Satellite Applications Catapult › 來源中的資訊
- [[Space Supply Chain]]（來源正文未標示正式發布日期；raw converted 2026-09-17）列出連結文字 `Space Capabilities Catalogue - Satellite Applications Catapult`，URL 為 `https://sa.catapult.org.uk/space-capabilities-catalogue/`。
- 本次 ingest 未擷取該外部網頁正文、更新日期、catalogue 版本、分類規則、公司名單、capabilities 條目或資料來源。

NTN signal generator solutions › End-to-end system testing
來源將 E2E system testing 描述為對 UE、NTN payload、service link channel emulator 與 feeder link channel emulator 的 RF satellite link emulation。[[R&S SMW200A]] 需要 firmware version ≥ 5.30，並透過 B14 或 B15 搭配 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading 支援：

- satellite trajectory modelling。
- frequency-dependent atmospheric effects。
- longer path delays。
- enhanced Doppler capabilities。
- up to 1073 ms delay。
- up to ±1 MHz Doppler（pure Doppler）。

[[R&S Space Nexus]] 在來源中被描述為 PC Software，available on request，可依 satellite trajectory 產生 [[R&S SMW200A]] fading files。

詳見 [[SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation]]。

R&S SMW200A
[[R&S SMW200A]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 vector signal generator；依 `R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator Specifications` `Version 31.00`（`May 2026`），RF path A 可覆蓋 `100 kHz to 67 GHz`，RF path B 可覆蓋至 `44 GHz`，並可由 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel MIMO receiver tester（來源：[[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]）。

SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600 › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[R&S SMW200A]]：本來源的主要產品實體，Rohde & Schwarz vector signal generator。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]]：文件發布組織與產品製造商。
- [[Vector signal generator]]：產品類別。
- [[RF path]]、[[RF modulation bandwidth]]、[[I-Q modulation]]、[[Phase noise]]、[[Floating license]]、[[Arbitrary waveform generator]]、[[AWGN]]、[[GNSS simulation]]、[[MIMO]]、[[Fading simulator]]、[[R&S WinIQSIM2]]、[[R&S Pulse Sequencer]]、[[HUMS]]：來源中反覆出現的概念或相鄰產品／軟體。

R&S SMCV100B › Arbitrary waveform generator
| 條件 | Waveform length |
|---|---|
| Standard | `1 sample to 64 Msample`, one-sample steps |
| with `R&S®SMCVB-K511` | `1 sample to 512 Msample` |
| with `R&S®SMCVB-K512` | `1 sample to 1 Gsample` |

Sample rate：standard `400 Hz to 75 MHz`；with `R&S®SMCVB-K521` `400 Hz to 150 MHz`；with `R&S®SMCVB-K522` `400 Hz to 200 MHz`；with `R&S®SMCVB-K523` `400 Hz to 300 MHz`；HDD streaming standard `400 Hz to 75 MHz` 需 `R&S®SMCVB-K505`。

Arbitrary waveform mode RF bandwidth：standard maximum sample rate `60 MHz`；with `R&S®SMCVB-K521` `120 MHz`；with `R&S®SMCVB-K522` `160 MHz`；with `R&S®SMCVB-K523` `240 MHz`。Frequency offset setting range：standard `–30 MHz to 30 MHz`；with `K521` `–60 MHz to 60 MHz`；with `K522` `–80 MHz to 80 MHz`；with `K523` `–120 MHz to 120 MHz`。

Triggering and markers：trigger source internal 或 external；trigger modes auto、retrig、armed auto、armed retrig、single；external trigger input selectable from user 1 or user 2，`BNC female`，input level `0 V to 3 V nominal`，threshold `0.1 V to 2.0 V`，input impedance selectable `1 kΩ` or `50 Ω nominal`，trigger jitter `±1.67 ns`。Marker signals number `1`，operating modes unchanged、restart、pulse、pattern、ratio，level `LVTTL`。

Multisegment waveform mode：segments `1 to 1024`，changeover modes GUI、remote control、external trigger，sequencer play list length max. `1024`，segment repetitions max. `1048575`。

Multicarrier waveform mode：carriers max. `512`；total RF bandwidth standard `60 MHz`，with `K521` `120 MHz`，with `K522` `160 MHz`，with `K523` `240 MHz`。

R&S SMW200A › Wideband baseband
- `R&S®SMW-B9` arbitrary waveform mode：waveform length `1 sample to 256 Msample`；with `K515` 到 `2 Gsample`。
- `R&S®SMW-B9` sample rate：`400 Hz to 600 MHz`；with `K525` 為 `400 Hz to 1200 MHz`；with `K527` 為 `400 Hz to 2400 MHz`。
- `R&S®SMW-B9` RF bandwidth：`500 MHz`；with `K525` 為 `1000 MHz`；with `K527` 為 `2000 MHz`。
- `R&S®SMW-B9F` 詳細 GNSS 規格見 `GNSS simulation for Rohde & Schwarz vector signal generators specifications`，文件 `PD 3607.6896.22`。

S-SSS › 使用限制
- 來源未保留 first ID / second ID 的正式符號與範圍。
- 來源未提供 full S-SSS interleaving formula。
- 來源未標示 [[3GPP TS 38.211]] 的 version；只提供 Section 8.4.2 / 8.4.3 的引用線索。

富喬 › 來源中的說法
- [[AI Server PCB test image 25]]（Nov., 2025；取得於 2026-09-04）在[[玻纖布]]分類列出富喬。
- [[HSD PCB image 15]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）在玻纖布表格下方註記「主要相關台廠為:南亞(1303)、台玻(1802)、富喬(1815)、玻纖紗布:建榮(5340)、石英布:德宏(5475)」。
- [[HSD PCB image 18]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）在 [[Low Dk]] / [[Low Df]]（低損耗）區塊寫：「降低訊號損耗，AI/5G 標配（富喬、台玻 主力衝刺區）。」
- [[HSD PCB image 8]]（來源未標示日期；converted 2026-09-04）在 [[Low Dk]] / [[Low Df]]（低損耗）區塊同樣寫：「降低訊號損耗，AI/5G 標配（富喬、台玻 主力衝刺區）。」

R&S PCB test solutions
[[R&S PCB test solutions]] 是 [[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]] Slide 21 對 PCB Fabricator and System House 的 PCB / high-speed digital 測試流程摘要，涵蓋 material measurement、stackup selection、signal integrity modeling/testing、sampling testing 與 process monitoring。

AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping
[[AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping]] 是用來保存 [[AISeverEcosystem]] 中 AI server ecosystem 分類與 [[R&S Solution]] 欄位對應關係的概念頁；它只表示該 Excel 表中的銷售 / 測試方案線索，不代表正式產品配置、客戶關係或已驗證商機。

[[Data center full-spectrum connectivity]] 是 [[full-spectrum-data-center-connectivity-brochure]] 呈現的 portfolio 視角：把 AI / data center 的 high-speed electrical interconnect、optical interconnect、fiber deployment、rack power distribution、busbar、liquid cooling 與 leak detection 放在同一張 data center connectivity brochure 中。

Satellite Applications Catapult
[[Satellite Applications Catapult]]是 [[Space Supply Chain]] 中 `Space Capabilities Catalogue` 外部連結 URL 所指向的組織 / 網站名稱線索；本 vault 目前尚未擷取該 catalogue 正文。

NTN signal generator solutions
[[NTN signal generator solutions]] 是 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]]（封面標示 12-2025；末頁標示 Last updated: 08/25）中用來整理 [[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S FSW]] 與相關 software options 在 [[3GPP]] [[NTN]] 測試中的 solution-level 應用框架。

R&S Space Nexus
[[R&S Space Nexus]] 是 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 27 中列出的 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] PC software，來源說它 available on request，可依 satellite trajectory 產生 [[R&S SMW200A]] fading files。

S-SSS › 基本性質
依 [[S-SSB]]：

- [[S-SSS]] 是 [[Sidelink SSB]] / [[S-SS-PSBCH block]] 的四個組成之一。
- Like standard [[SSS]]，[[S-SSS]] consists of 127 [[BPSK]] modulation symbols。
- Sequence is based on two Fibonacci [[LFSR]]s of length 7：
  - `x0` with taps [7,3]。
  - `x1` with taps [7,6]。
- Final sequence `d` is obtained by interleaving the two LFSR outputs depending on the [[Sidelink identity]]，in same way as standard [[SSS]]；但來源中的完整公式 / identity 符號因轉檔遺失。
- Overall 672 different S-SSS sequences are defined because sequence generation depends on the first and second ID。

NTN signal generator solutions › Component testing
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 16，component testing 使用 DUT、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 [[R&S FSW]]：

- [[R&S SMW200A]]：frequency up to 67 GHz，overrange 72 GHz；RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz，up to 4 GHz with [[R&S SMW-K555]]。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] signal generation SW：LTE、Cellular IoT、5G NR R17/18（K171）、OFDM signal generation（K114）、custom digital modulation。
- [[R&S FSW]]：frequency up to 85 GHz，overrange 90 GHz；analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz。
- [[R&S FSW]] signal analysis SW：LTE、Cellular IoT、5G NR R17/18（K171）、OFDM signal analysis（K96）、Vector signal analysis（K70）。

以上是 2025 簡報摘要值；正式產品規格仍需回查 [[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S FSW]] 與其對應 specifications。

- [[Amphenol BarKlip I-O products]] / [[BarKlip Busbar Connectors]] — 來源稱其 distribute high-current power between busbars、cables and circuit boards，適用 power-dense data centers、OCP rack and power solutions。
- [[60 A Universal AC Input Connector and Cable Assemblies]] — 來源稱其 meet 2OU power distribution architecture standards，將 power 從 busway routing 到 power shelf。
- [[M-CRPS +54V Connectors and Cable Assemblies]] — 來源稱其 meet OCP M-CRPS power supply input specifications。
- [[PwrBlade ULTRA HD+ Cable Assembly]] — 來源稱其 Cable-to-Board serves as high-power I/O cable configuration in a low-profile design。
- [[OSFP-RHS 224G Cold Plate and Cage Assembly]] — 來源稱其 optimizes port thermal efficiency and reliability，meeting MSA requirements，並提供 one-step press assembly。
- [[Amphenol Liquid Cooling Leakage Detection Sensor Cable Assembly]] — 來源稱其 detects coolant leaks and ensures system reliability。
- [[Liquid Cooling Quick Disconnect Connectors]] — 來源稱其用於 high-efficiency thermal management。

VIAVI O-RU Tester › 來源中的角色：August 2023
依 [[R&S portfolio for O-RU testing]] Slide 8：

- Solution 標題為 `VIAVI and R&S O-RU Tester solution`。
- 圖中 [[VIAVI O-RU Tester]] 連到：
  - RF。
  - O-RAN FH。
  - PTP。
  - T-BC。
  - FTN。
  - Management。
  - 10 MHz Ref。
  - Ethernet switch / eCPRI。
  - O-RU DUT。
- 同一圖中 R&S 側包含：
  - [[R&S VSE]]。
  - [[R&S SMW200A]] / [[R&S SMBV100B]] Vector Signal Generator。
  - [[R&S FSW]] / [[R&S FSVA3000]]。
  - Interconnection Unit。
  - O-RU TMA。
  - Optional control PC。
- 圖上文字把整合目的連到 `3GPP RF Pre-Conformance Validation` 與 `O-RAN WG4 CUSM Conformance Test (ORAN-WG4.CONF-v06.00)`。

依 [[R&S portfolio for O-RU testing]] Slide 10：

- R&S provides the signal generation and analysis interfaces to the VIAVI O-RU tester。
- R&S 的角色不是在此來源中取代 O-RU tester，而是提供 signal generation、signal analysis、VSE 軟體與相關 RF test equipment。

answer.text:
The passages support prioritizing AI-ready signal generation around automated end-to-end test planning, smart execution of complex test scenarios, lab-management integration, DUT capability management, and log-based result/root-cause analysis, because the RAW AI outlook lists these as the focus areas for agentic AI in CONTEST sequencer operation [37].
For test-and-measurement signal generators themselves, the key capabilities are wide RF frequency coverage, wide RF modulation bandwidth, standards-based signal generation, OFDM/custom digital modulation, arbitrary waveform generation, multicarrier waveforms, MIMO/multichannel expansion, fading/channel emulation, and programmable trigger/marker control [5][6][28].
R&S SMW200A is relevant where AI test workflows need high-end vector signal generation, because the Wiki states it covers RF path A from 100 kHz to 67 GHz and can scale from a single-path vector signal generator to a multichannel MIMO receiver tester [3].
For component-level wireless testing, the supported SMW200A capabilities include frequency up to 67 GHz, overrange to 72 GHz, RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz, up to 4 GHz with R&S SMW-K555, and signal generation software for LTE, Cellular IoT, 5G NR R17/18, OFDM, and custom digital modulation [28].
For interference and multi-signal test cases, multicarrier generation matters, because SMCV100B supports up to 512 carriers and total RF bandwidth up to 240 MHz with K523 [5].
For repeatable automated execution, trigger and marker control matter, because SMCV100B supports internal or external trigger sources, multiple trigger modes, external trigger input, trigger jitter of ±1.67 ns, and LVTTL marker output [5].
【推論】The most AI-relevant signal-generator capability is not only RF performance but controllable scenario automation, because RAW AI evidence emphasizes automated test plan generation and smart execution of complex scenarios, while the signal-generator evidence lists waveform sequencing, modulation, bandwidth, fading, and trigger/marker controls [37][5][6][28][2].

NTN signal generator solutions › End-to-end system testing
來源將 E2E system testing 描述為對 UE、NTN payload、service link channel emulator 與 feeder link channel emulator 的 RF satellite link emulation。[[R&S SMW200A]] 需要 firmware version ≥ 5.30，並透過 B14 或 B15 搭配 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading 支援：

- satellite trajectory modelling。
- frequency-dependent atmospheric effects。
- longer path delays。
- enhanced Doppler capabilities。
- up to 1073 ms delay。
- up to ±1 MHz Doppler（pure Doppler）。

[[R&S Space Nexus]] 在來源中被描述為 PC Software，available on request，可依 satellite trajectory 產生 [[R&S SMW200A]] fading files。

詳見 [[SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation]]。

R&S SMW200A
[[R&S SMW200A]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 vector signal generator；依 `R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator Specifications` `Version 31.00`（`May 2026`），RF path A 可覆蓋 `100 kHz to 67 GHz`，RF path B 可覆蓋至 `44 GHz`，並可由 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel MIMO receiver tester（來源：[[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]）。

R&S SMCV100B › Arbitrary waveform generator
| 條件 | Waveform length |
|---|---|
| Standard | `1 sample to 64 Msample`, one-sample steps |
| with `R&S®SMCVB-K511` | `1 sample to 512 Msample` |
| with `R&S®SMCVB-K512` | `1 sample to 1 Gsample` |

Sample rate：standard `400 Hz to 75 MHz`；with `R&S®SMCVB-K521` `400 Hz to 150 MHz`；with `R&S®SMCVB-K522` `400 Hz to 200 MHz`；with `R&S®SMCVB-K523` `400 Hz to 300 MHz`；HDD streaming standard `400 Hz to 75 MHz` 需 `R&S®SMCVB-K505`。

Arbitrary waveform mode RF bandwidth：standard maximum sample rate `60 MHz`；with `R&S®SMCVB-K521` `120 MHz`；with `R&S®SMCVB-K522` `160 MHz`；with `R&S®SMCVB-K523` `240 MHz`。Frequency offset setting range：standard `–30 MHz to 30 MHz`；with `K521` `–60 MHz to 60 MHz`；with `K522` `–80 MHz to 80 MHz`；with `K523` `–120 MHz to 120 MHz`。

Triggering and markers：trigger source internal 或 external；trigger modes auto、retrig、armed auto、armed retrig、single；external trigger input selectable from user 1 or user 2，`BNC female`，input level `0 V to 3 V nominal`，threshold `0.1 V to 2.0 V`，input impedance selectable `1 kΩ` or `50 Ω nominal`，trigger jitter `±1.67 ns`。Marker signals number `1`，operating modes unchanged、restart、pulse、pattern、ratio，level `LVTTL`。

Multisegment waveform mode：segments `1 to 1024`，changeover modes GUI、remote control、external trigger，sequencer play list length max. `1024`，segment repetitions max. `1048575`。

Multicarrier waveform mode：carriers max. `512`；total RF bandwidth standard `60 MHz`，with `K521` `120 MHz`，with `K522` `160 MHz`，with `K523` `240 MHz`。

R&S SMW200A › Wideband baseband
- `R&S®SMW-B9` arbitrary waveform mode：waveform length `1 sample to 256 Msample`；with `K515` 到 `2 Gsample`。
- `R&S®SMW-B9` sample rate：`400 Hz to 600 MHz`；with `K525` 為 `400 Hz to 1200 MHz`；with `K527` 為 `400 Hz to 2400 MHz`。
- `R&S®SMW-B9` RF bandwidth：`500 MHz`；with `K525` 為 `1000 MHz`；with `K527` 為 `2000 MHz`。
- `R&S®SMW-B9F` 詳細 GNSS 規格見 `GNSS simulation for Rohde & Schwarz vector signal generators specifications`，文件 `PD 3607.6896.22`。

NTN signal generator solutions › Component testing
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 16，component testing 使用 DUT、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 [[R&S FSW]]：

- [[R&S SMW200A]]：frequency up to 67 GHz，overrange 72 GHz；RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz，up to 4 GHz with [[R&S SMW-K555]]。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] signal generation SW：LTE、Cellular IoT、5G NR R17/18（K171）、OFDM signal generation（K114）、custom digital modulation。

- [[R&S FSW]] signal analysis SW：LTE、Cellular IoT、5G NR R17/18（K171）、OFDM signal analysis（K96）、Vector signal analysis（K70）。
